registration.statement: The chemical-potential-equivalent of one held component is its complete exact marginal addition account in a named phase: retained-energy increment and closed-distinction increment. At one fixed finite environment, paired component exchange is directed only by strict product order; exact account equality is equilibrium with structural EmptyOne separations and does not require equal bulk phase compositions. All 74 multicomponent equilibrium identities seal before compound, temperature, pressure or composition values open.
